info.name: Apache Version Detect
info.description: Detects the installed version of Apache HTTP Server

info.name: Apache 2.4.51 - Buffer Overflow
info.description: A carefully crafted URI body can cause a buffer overflow in the mod_lua multipart parser. This affects Apache HTTP Server 2.4.51 and earlier.
info.remediation: Upgrade Apache HTTP Server to version 2.4.52 or later.

info.name: Apache 2.4.51 - Path Traversal
info.description: It was found that the fix for CVE-2021-41773 in Apache HTTP Server 2.4.50 was insufficient. An attacker could use a path traversal attack to map URLs to files outside directories configured by Alias-like directives.
info.remediation: Upgrade Apache HTTP Server to version 2.4.52 or later.

info.name: MySQL Default Credentials
info.description: MySQL server is accessible with default credentials (root:root)
info.remediation: Change the default root password and restrict MySQL access.

info.name: Redis Unauthorized Access
info.description: Redis server is accessible without authentication
info.remediation: Enable Redis authentication with requirepass directive and restrict network access.

info.name: Reflected XSS
info.description: A reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability was detected
info.remediation: Implement proper output encoding and input validation.
